title: Primary
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a logo configuration for the space it must occupy. A recognizable arrangement can remain legible in a narrower format if the alternate is chosen deliberately.
strategic_value: The organization can build familiarity with its primary signature while accommodating square or horizontally constrained surfaces.
demonstration: The white upper band labels the wordmark and symbol of the primary logo. A gray lower band shows the more tightly stacked secondary arrangement with the same components labeled.
practical_value: Start with the primary lockup and consider the secondary version where horizontal room is limited.

content_islands.name: Primary lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the guidance at left and a large primary specimen at right. Bracket and label its two components.

content_islands.name: Secondary alternative
content_islands.spec: Repeat the comparison on a pale lower band. Show how the wordmark stacks and the symbol sits beside it. Keep the usage note with the secondary specimen.
